info.title: OSPF_Neighbor
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

bdr.description: OSPFv2 Router Interface IP or OSPFv3 Router ID of the Backup Designated Router. The Router ID is in IPv4 address format.

dr.description: OSPFv2 Router Interface IP or OSPFv3 Router ID of the Designated Router. The Router ID is in IPv4 address format.

nbr_if_addr.description: The interface address of the OSPF Neighbor on which the neighbor relationship is established.

nbr_options.description: The neighbor options or capabilities such as Opaque LSA capability, Demand Circuit, External Attribute LSA capability, and so on.

nbr_priority.description: The priority of the neighbor. The default value is 255.

nbr_router_id.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Neighbor](#/OSPF_Neighbor)
The Neighbor Router ID is used to identify the neighbor. The Neighbor Router ID is in IPv4 address format.

nfsm_state.description: OSPF Neighbor FSM states. The default value is "down".

ospf_interface.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Neighbor](#/OSPF_Neighbor)
Interface to which the neighbor belongs.

ls_retransmit_queue_len.description: Current length of the retransmission queue.

state_changes_count.description: The total number of state change events on this interface.

dead_timer_due.description: The time left for the dead timer of the neighbor to expire. The default value is the dead_interval for the interface.

dr_rtr_state.description: The designated router state of this neighbor. "desig_rtr_other" indicates that the router is neither designated router nor the backup designated router. "desig_rtr_dr" indicates that the router is the designated router. "desig_rtr_bdr" indicates that the router is the backup designated router. This field is not applicable for the point-to-point links.

time_of_last_change.description: Time of the neighbor state change in seconds since Epoch.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: OSPF_Router.instance_tag
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Router](#/OSPF_Router)
The list of all the OSPFv2 Router instances.

parameters.name: OSPF_Area.area_id
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Area](#/OSPF_Area)
The list of all the "OSPF_Area" for the OSPF router instance, which contains the OSPFv2 area related configurations. The Area ID is in IPv4 address format.

parameters.name: OSPF_Interface.interface_name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Interface](#/OSPF_Interface)
The list of all the "OSPF_Interface" for the OSPF Area, which contains the OSPF interface related configurations, statuses, and statistics.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
